Name: Better Artisan Good Icons for Joja Seeds
Author: waterscapes
Description:
Do you love being a shill for Joja? Me too. I love it so much that I felt the need to create some artisan icons for a mod I love very much, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8746]Joja Seeds[/url]. The caps for Joja Seeds are Joja Blue, and the caps for Heirloom crops are rainbow!

Special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/114762643]CopperSun[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/44734342]CatCattyCat[/url] for giving me permission to use their assets and make this mod. I'd also like to thank [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/40077065]MrTiddles93[/url], who created the Love of Cooking BAGI icons that I used as a base for the Heirloom Carrot icons, and who allows their assets to be used with credit. 

This is my first ever mod so if you have any constructive feedback on how everything looks please let me know!

How to Install:
1. Extract "[BAGI] Joja Seeds" into your Mods folder.

How to Uninstall:
1. Delete "[BAGI] Joja Seeds" from your Mods folder.
